tips: U can set teh rum size up ta 24 playrz.
U can set rum round tiem from 5 2 150 secondz.
[Scramble] iz a moed whar u look at mixd-up letterz n guess teh wurd.
[Anythin] iz a moed whar u can type any wurd in teh langwidge 2 pass teh turn.
[Calc Relay] iz a moed whar playrz take turnz solvin math on teh screen.
[Calc Battle] iz a moed whar u race 2 solve math as fast as u can.
If a problem in [Calc Battle] iz 2 hard, type 'gg' 2 skip it.
If u cant solve [Initial Quiz] or [Scramble], type 'gg' 2 give up.
[Chain Battle] iz a moed whar u play wurd relay alone wif a startin letter n see who can maek moar wurdz.
[Panel Flip] iz a moed whar u type wurdz on teh board 2 maek panelz urs. Ur score iz how many panelz u haz.
[Speed Quiz] iz a moed whar u type teh answr 2 teh quiz on teh screen.
If evryone iz redy but teh hoast doesnt start, teh hoast becomes a watchr aftr 1 minute n teh gaem starts.
If teh hoast iz watchin, teh gaem starts by itself 1 minute aftr evryone iz redy.
A rum wifout a passwurd that nobody plays in (practis too) 4 10 minutes goes bye-bye.
[Manner] rul blocks wurdz nobody can chain after n wurdz dat can only be used wunce. [Shi.] rul only blocks teh 2nd kind, so u can still use wurdz nobody can chain after.
If u turn on [Easy Mis.], u finish mishunz by matchin teh consonant n vowel, even if teh final consonant iz difrent.
If u turn on [More Mis.], vowelz liek ㅓ, ㅗ, ㅜ, ㅔ, ㅣ show up as mishunz 2, not just ㅏ.
If u turn on [Special], u can use verbz n adjectivez, n wif [Flexible], even weirdr wurdz work!
[Item Mode] haz 5 tipez of itemz: Skip, Reverse, Pass, Random, Middle/End Relay. Middle/End Relay only shows up in KKuTu moedz.
[Skip] item skips teh next playr aftr ur turn.
[Reverse] item flips teh turn direcshun b4 ur turn.
[Pass] item sends teh turn 2 teh next playr b4 ur turn.
[Random] item sends teh turn 2 a random playr aftr ur turn.
[Middle] n [Wordchain] itemz change teh relay 2 middle or end, but only 4 u.
If u turn on [Goodword], u cant use wurdz wif swearz.
In [K. KungKungTta], u use 3-letter wurdz, but u can change it 2 [3-2], [2-2], [4-4], [4-3].
In [E. KungKungTta], u use 5-letter wurdz, but special rulez let u pik 3~7 letterz.
If u turn on [Unknown], u can only use wurdz dat r not in teh dictionary.
If u turn on [Unknown], u can get up 2 100 EXP n 10 PINGS.
If u turn on [Triple] in Wurd Match, 3 topikz show up each round n u can use a wurd from any wun.
If u turn on [Big Board] in SokSok moed, teh letterz on screen get about 2x bigger.
If u turn on [1 Chance], it iz gaem ovr rite away wen u fail 2 type.
If u turn on [Survival], u start wif HP instead of score. Teh score u get hurtz teh playr next 2 u. Last wun standin wins.
If an item changes teh turn in Survival moed, teh damage goes 2 teh new playr.
If u turn on [Return], u can use wurdz nobody used in teh last 5 turnz. But u get no pointz.
If u turn on [Middle], u chain wif teh middle letter. If teh wurd length iz even, u use teh letter in teh 2nd half.
If u turn on [Second], u chain wif teh 2nd-2-last letter.
If u turn on [Head], u chain wif teh very first letter.
If u turn on [Random], a random letter from teh wurd iz used 2 chain. Letterz nobody can chain after dont show up in Manner moed.
In KKuTu moedz, teh letter u chain wif iz lite blue.
If u turn on [Long] in Typin Battle, 9~13 letter wurdz show up instead of 2~5.
If u turn on [Vowel] in Initial Quiz, u play wif vowelz.
If u turn on [Unlimited] in quiz moedz, answerz can be any length.
Initial Quiz n Picture Quiz haz 2~7 letter answerz, n Scramble haz 4~7.
If u turn on [Free Ini] in Wurd Relay, u can change ㄹ 2 ㄴ or ㅇ freely, no matter teh vowel.
If u use [Vowel Inv] in Wurd Relay, u can chain by flippin Yin/Yang vowelz.
If u turn on [Speed], turn tiem iz half but round tiem stays teh same.
In Hunminjeongeum, u can giv 3 initial consonantz instead of 2.
U get Toss Bonus wen ur wurd ends wif teh first letter of teh last wurd.
U get Straight Bonus wen ur wurd gets longr wunce per wurd, 2+ tiemz in a row.
U get Full House Bonus wen ur wurd haz evry letter u sent b4.
U get Jackpot Bonus wen u send wurdz of teh same length 3+ tiemz in a row. Length must be 7+.
U get Flush Bonus wen u pass teh same letter 3+ tiemz.
U get Defense Bonus wen u stop an attak wurd or flush wurd.
Plz dont turn on [Drug]... Anyway...
If u turn on [Apple] in Korean SokSok, u can watch Bad Apple.
If u turn on [Stonks], all bonus pointz (mishun, toss, straight, etc.) r doubld.
Wif [Falloff], u get 0 pointz if u fail teh turn. Wif [God mode], u dont lose pointz.
[Safe] rul stops u from losin pointz if u cant chain cuz of a wurd dat can only be used wunce.
Speed Quiz difficulty haz Easy, Normal, Hard. U can pik moar den wun.
[No Long] n [No Short] block 9+ letterz n 8- letterz.
[Catch] in Picture Quiz uses special catch-mind style wurdz.
If u turn on [Only Once], wurdz used in a round cant be used in teh rounds aftr.
In [Letter Lab] undr [Edit Profile], u can mix up 2 10 letterz n get rewardz.
In [Item Workshop] undr [Edit Profile], u can mix 2 itemz 2 maek a nu wun.
U can pik langwidge in teh settingz at teh top-left. Korean, English, n ??? r there.
U can pik sound pak in teh settingz at teh top-left. Dere r 6 sound paks rite nao.
U can change level icon n BGM in teh settingz at teh top-left.
Wen u maek a rum, clik [View All Rules] 2 c evry special rul. Turn off [Simple Rum View] in settingz 2 always c dem.
Wif [Show Rule Categories] in settingz, u can group rulez by tipe.
Wif [Reduce Shake] in settingz, u can stop screen shake from long wurdz or [Drug].
Wif [Auto-fill AI Settings], an AI bot's last settingz load wen u set it up.
In Wordchain, letterz nobody can chain after r red, attak wurdz r orange, defend wurdz r blue.
Wen u practis or invite KKuTu Bot, u can set its strategy (Long-wurd 2 Aggressive).
If u set KKuTu Bot's favorite letterz, it tries 2 giv u mostly dose.
If u turn on KKuTu Bot's chat, it talks wen it sendz/gets wurdz dat can only be used wunce or wen sumone misses a turn.
If u turn on KKuTu Bot's fast moed, it ignorez strategy n types as fast as it can.
If u turn on KKuTu Bot's rage-quit, it leavez if it gets 2 many wurdz dat can only be used wunce.
Dere r about 1.5 million Korean wurdz in KKuTu-N rite nao.
N in KKuTu-N stands fer Nu.
Teh maker of KKuTu-N also maed KKuTu.site, a servr list.
Copyright info for KKuTu-N iz at teh bottom in [Copyright Info].
KKuTu-N wuz first maed on Nov 25, 2025 n shown 2 evryone on Dec 3, 2025.
Clik [View All Rules] 2 c evry rul 4 teh gaem moed.
[Wurd Rain] iz a moed whar u type wurdz fallin from teh top b4 dey hit teh groun. If u type a wurd rite, u can attak othrs.
Teh [Even] strategy attakz evry enemy teh same.
Teh [K.Os] strategy attakz teh enemy wif teh lowest HP 2 get a KO.
Teh [Payback] strategy attakz teh last enemy hu attakd u.
KKuTu Bot uses [K.Os] wif [Aggressive] personality, [Payback] wif [Long Words] personality, n [Even] wif [Balanced] personality.
[369 Game] iz a gaem whar u take turnz countin from 1. If a numbr haz 3, 6, or 9, clap (use 짝, ㅉ, clap, or c) wunce 4 each 3, 6, or 9 in it instead of sayin teh numbr.
